title: Downstream impact of early layer scaling

cues.en: Welcome to this section of the course.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到這個課程章節。

cues.en: All of the videos in this section are focused on modifying the hidden states, which are the outputs of the transformer blocks.
cues.zh: 這個章節所有影片，都聚焦於修改隱藏狀態，也就是 Transformer 區塊的輸出。

cues.en: Of course, a lot of the concepts and code that you will learn about in this section are relevant for any kind of causal manipulations in any part of the model.
cues.zh: 當然，這裡學到的許多概念與程式碼，也適用於模型任何部分的各種因果操作。

cues.en: In this first code demo, I will follow up on an observation from the previous section, which was that
cues.zh: 第一個程式示範，會延續上一個章節的一項觀察，也就是

cues.en: when you modify the activations in one layer, that has an impact on what happens in later layers, but not in earlier layers.
cues.zh: 修改某一層的活化，會影響後面的層，但不會影響前面的層。

cues.en: On the one hand, that is kind of obvious, but it does lend itself to lots of interesting analyses
cues.zh: 一方面，這有點顯而易見，但也能延伸出很多有趣的分析

cues.en: that we can apply and experiments that we can run, for example, to investigate which layers are most
cues.zh: 與實驗，例如研究哪些層，對於表徵文字的不同特徵，

cues.en: important for representing different features of text or different contextual information.
cues.zh: 或不同的上下文資訊最重要。

cues.en: There's not much theory or math that you need here, so let me jump right into the overview of the code demo.
cues.zh: 這裡不需要很多理論或數學，所以直接來概述程式示範。

cues.en: I will use GPT two and create a hook that simply grabs the hidden states that were already calculated
cues.zh: 我會使用 GPT2，建立一個 hook，取得這一層已經計算好的

cues.en: in this layer, and then scale the whole thing down by some scaling factor and then return that scaled output.
cues.zh: 隱藏狀態，再依照某個縮放因子縮小全部數值，傳回縮放後的輸出。

cues.en: So here you see the hook function.
cues.zh: 這裡就是 hook 函數。

cues.en: So I'm grabbing the output of this layer.
cues.zh: 取出這一層的輸出。

cues.en: And in this case I've hardcoded this to be layer two.
cues.zh: 這裡，我把它寫死為第二號層。

cues.en: And then I just scale by multiplying this hidden states tensor by some scaling factor, and then pack
cues.zh: 接著，只要讓隱藏狀態張量乘上某個縮放因子，再把輸出

cues.en: up the output again into a tuple before returning it.
cues.zh: 重新包成元組，然後傳回。

cues.en: And actually you see that the way that I have written this code here does literally nothing.
cues.zh: 其實可以看到，目前這樣寫，真的什麼都沒做。

cues.en: I set the scaling factor to be one.
cues.zh: 縮放因子設成一。

cues.en: So I'm just multiplying the embeddings vectors by one.
cues.zh: 所以，只是讓嵌入向量乘以一。

cues.en: But this here this is a globally defined variable.
cues.zh: 但這是全域定義的變數。

cues.en: It's not defined inside.
cues.zh: 不是定義在裡面。

cues.en: The function is defined outside of the hook function.
cues.zh: 它定義在 hook 函數外。

cues.en: So it's global as global scope.
cues.zh: 所以，是全域，具有全域作用域。

cues.en: And that means that I can change this to be less than one or greater than one.
cues.zh: 這代表，可以把它改成小於一或大於一。

cues.en: I can change this variable dynamically as I'm running experiments and exploring the impact of scaling.
cues.zh: 執行實驗、探索縮放影響時，可以動態修改這個變數。

cues.en: And also just to be clear, in case this wasn't clear enough from the previous section, this variable output here, this is the output of this layer.
cues.zh: 也說清楚，免得上一個章節還不夠清楚，這裡的 output 變數，就是這一層的輸出。

cues.en: So before I get this variable output, the model has already run through attention and MLP, adding those adjustments back onto the residual stream layer norms.
cues.zh: 因此，在取得 output 變數之前，模型已經執行過注意力、MLP，把調整加回殘差流，還有層正規化，

cues.en: ET cetera.
cues.zh: 等等。

cues.en: ET cetera.
cues.zh: 等等。

cues.en: Everything that happens in Transformer Block two has already happened.
cues.zh: Transformer 第二號區塊內的所有事情，都已經發生。

cues.en: It's already been calculated.
cues.zh: 都已經計算完畢。

cues.en: And here I'm grabbing the results of all of those calculations.
cues.zh: 我在這裡取得那些計算的結果。

cues.en: And then I apply this manipulation and then replace the output with this modified version.
cues.zh: 再施加這個操作，用修改後版本替換輸出。

cues.en: Okay, so what I return from this hook function ends up being the input into the next transformer block.
cues.zh: 所以，hook 函數傳回的內容，最後會成為下一個 Transformer 區塊的輸入。

cues.en: And another reminder this variable here this output variable.
cues.zh: 再提醒一次，這裡這個 output 變數，

cues.en: This is a tuple.
cues.zh: 是元組。

cues.en: It is not a tuple if you hook into the attention or MLP layers directly, but it is a tuple for the final output of the transformer block.
cues.zh: 直接掛接注意力或 MLP 層時，不是元組；但 Transformer 區塊的最終輸出，就是元組。

cues.en: Now the first element of this tuple, that's the thing that we want.
cues.zh: 這個元組的第一個元素，就是我們要的東西。

cues.en: And it's also what hugging face refers to as the hidden states.
cues.zh: 也是 Hugging Face 所稱的隱藏狀態。

cues.en: Now, whether there are other elements in this tuple depends on the inputs that you provide when calling the forward pass through the model.
cues.zh: 元組是否有其他元素，取決於呼叫模型前向傳播時提供的輸入。

cues.en: I'm going to discuss this explicitly and show some examples in a later video in this section.
cues.zh: 這個章節稍後的影片，會明確討論、展示一些例子。

cues.en: For now, this tuple actually only has one element, so this variable rest will be empty.
cues.zh: 目前，這個元組其實只有一個元素，所以 rest 變數會是空的。

cues.en: But anyway, it's good to be in the habit of including this.
cues.zh: 不過，養成包含它的習慣很好。

cues.en: Otherwise it can cause some serious issues if you do have multiple elements in this output tuple.
cues.zh: 否則，如果輸出元組真的有多個元素，可能造成嚴重問題。

cues.en: Okay, so more on that in a future video.
cues.zh: 好，之後的影片再多談。

cues.en: I have a little bit of text to push through.
cues.zh: 我有一小段文字要送進去。

cues.en: It is ten tokens.
cues.zh: 有十個 token。

cues.en: And of course there are 13 hidden states 768 dimensions in GPT two.
cues.zh: 當然，GPT2 small 有 13 個隱藏狀態、768 個維度。

cues.en: Small.
cues.zh: 也就是小版本。

cues.en: Now what I have done is run the forward pass with this hook implanted and storing all of the hidden states twice.
cues.zh: 我植入這個 hook，執行兩次前向傳播，並儲存全部隱藏狀態。

cues.en: The first time I did the forward pass, I pushed all the tokens through with this scaling factor of one.
cues.zh: 第一次前向傳播，讓所有 token 通過，縮放因子為一。

cues.en: That means that absolutely nothing happened, except that we wasted like a tiny bit of computation time just to run this code here.
cues.zh: 這代表，絕對什麼都沒發生，只是執行這段程式碼，浪費一點點計算時間。

cues.en: So that is the unscaled version of the data.
cues.zh: 所以，這是沒有縮放的資料版本。

cues.en: In other words, there were no manipulations or modulations of the activations.
cues.zh: 換句話說，沒有對活化做任何操作或調變。

cues.en: That's a pure copy of the model internals.
cues.zh: 這是模型內部的純粹複本。

cues.en: Then I did a forward pass again with the same tokens, but now I set the scaling factor to be 0.5.
cues.zh: 接著，再用相同 token 做一次前向傳播，但縮放因子改成 0.5。

cues.en: So that means now that all of the hidden states from transformer block two were scaled by a factor of one half.
cues.zh: 所以，第二號 Transformer 區塊的所有隱藏狀態，都乘以二分之一。

cues.en: I didn't add any noise or swap the order of the dimensions or anything like that.
cues.zh: 我沒有加入雜訊、交換維度順序，或做其他事情。

cues.en: All I did was scale everything down, and that means that I now have two sets of hidden states, one
cues.zh: 只是縮小全部數值，這表示，現在有兩組隱藏狀態，

cues.en: from the original version of the model and one with the scaled vectors in transformer layer two.
cues.zh: 一組來自原始模型，另一組則縮放了第二號 Transformer 層的向量。

cues.en: So, to gain some insight into the impact of scaling, I calculated the difference between the two sets
cues.zh: 為了了解縮放的影響，我計算兩組隱藏狀態

cues.en: of hidden state matrices and then calculated the norm of that matrix.
cues.zh: 矩陣的差，再計算那個矩陣的範數。

cues.en: And the idea is that if the two matrices are identical, then the norm of their difference is exactly zero.
cues.zh: 概念是，如果兩個矩陣相同，差矩陣的範數就剛好為零。

cues.en: And that you see here for the embeddings layer and for the first two transformer blocks.
cues.zh: 這裡的嵌入層，以及前兩個 Transformer 區塊，就是如此。

cues.en: And then here it's in transformer block two where I introduced the scaling.
cues.zh: 接著，在第二號 Transformer 區塊施加縮放。

cues.en: So now suddenly the matrix difference norm jumps up.
cues.zh: 所以，矩陣差的範數突然跳高。

cues.en: Now that part is not at all surprising.
cues.zh: 這部分一點都不令人意外。

cues.en: I scaled it down by a factor of one half.
cues.zh: 我把它縮小為一半。

cues.en: So of course there is.
cues.zh: 所以，當然有，

cues.en: There are some differences.
cues.zh: 有一些差異。

cues.en: The interesting question is what happens in the layers thereafter?
cues.zh: 有趣的問題是，之後的層發生什麼？

cues.en: You can imagine that the model would maybe adapt to the smaller activations and simply figure out a
cues.zh: 你可以想像，模型也許會適應較小的活化，想出

cues.en: way to scale up the smaller numbers, so that after a couple of layers, they end up being the same as without the downsampling.
cues.zh: 放大較小數字的方式，讓它們經過幾層之後，與沒有縮小時一樣。

cues.en: But actually, though, what ends up happening is that the two sets of matrices continue to diverge
cues.zh: 但實際上，這兩組矩陣，隨著

cues.en: as we get deeper into the model, although they do move towards each other at the final transformer block.
cues.zh: 越深入模型，持續分歧；不過，最後一個 Transformer 區塊時，兩者會稍微靠近。

cues.en: So there is something at the very end that is able to compensate at least a little bit for the disruption that happened earlier in the model.
cues.zh: 所以，最末端有某種東西，至少能稍微補償模型前面發生的干擾。

cues.en: By the way, this plot here shows the results excluding the first token.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這張圖的結果排除了第一個 token。

cues.en: It looks quite a bit different when we include the first token in this analysis.
cues.zh: 如果分析包含第一個 token，看起來會很不一樣。

cues.en: Okay, so is this just a bunch of numbers or does this have any actual impact on the model's behavior.
cues.zh: 好，這只是一堆數字，還是真的會影響模型行為？

cues.en: And by behavior I mean the actual tokens that it generates and the distribution of the final output logits over the vocab?
cues.zh: 行為指的是實際產生的 token，以及最終輸出 logit 在詞彙表上的分布。

cues.en: I will let you ponder the answer to that question, and what you think will happen to the model's ability to predict tokens and generate new tokens.
cues.zh: 讓你思考這個問題的答案，以及你認為模型預測、產生新 token 的能力會發生什麼。

cues.en: We will do those kinds of investigations in later videos, but here in this demo, I'm really just going to focus on the code implementations and the model internals.
cues.zh: 之後的影片會做這類研究，但這個示範真的只聚焦於程式實作與模型內部。
